This is not a substantive contradiction of prior evidence; it is absence of evidence. The analysis states 'recent call showed complete disengagement risk' but a single failed connection does not prove disengagement—it proves the call didn't happen. Prior score of 4/10 was based on 'Nils and Christian and Graham mentioned as team members discussing strategy' from Call 1. A failed Call 2 does not negate Call 1 evidence. The Champion score should remain 4/10 with a note: 'No new information in Call 2 (call failed to connect). Maintaining prior assessment of 4/10. Failed connection warrants re-engagement urgency but does not contradict prior evidence of team discussion.' | CRITERION 4 VIOLATION - Next step for Champion uses vague language: 'Send urgent email to Christian Liebenow today, copy Nils Stotz. If they respond yes within 48 hours, schedule 30-minute working session to confirm Nils or Christian's internal selling efforts and map stakeholder alignment.'
